landing.heroDesc: Never miss a daily check-in again. GameClaw automatically claims your HoYoLAB rewards for Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, and more.
landing.featureAutoCheckinDesc: Automatically claim daily rewards across all your linked HoYoverse games, every single day.
landing.featureMultiGameDesc: Support for Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, Honkai Impact 3rd, and Tears of Themis.
landing.featureAISkillDesc: Use GameClaw as an AI skill — let your AI agent handle check-ins and account queries for you.
landing.featureSecureDesc: Your game credentials are encrypted at rest. Fully open source under MIT license.
landing.step1Desc: Securely link your HoYoLAB account using your browser cookies.
landing.step2Desc: Toggle automatic daily check-in for each of your linked games.
landing.step3Desc: Sit back and collect your daily rewards — primogems, Stellar Jade, and more.

accounts.title: Game Accounts
accounts.linkDesc: Enter your HoYoLAB cookies to link your game account. Your credentials are encrypted and stored securely.
accounts.cookieGuideSteps:
1. Visit hoyolab.com and log in
2. Press F12 to open Developer Tools
3. Go to Application > Cookies
4. Find and copy ltoken_v2 and ltuid_v2
accounts.linkError: Failed to link account. Please check your cookies.
